positions.name: AsyncJobContractRatification
positions.frame: how does the async job contract get settled into operational rules through ratification?
positions.why: Both expressions perform the settling of the async job contract as decided operational rules rather than argued proposals. src-1 carries Wynn's ratified declaration of the receipt-and-cursor terms with explicit guarantees (no blocking call, no lost work); src-2 summarizes the key decision as prescribed procedure (dispatch, then poll or piggyback). The conviction gradient runs from ratified collective agreement in src-1 to flat instrumental prescription in src-2, but both hold the same frame: the contract's terms are stated as settled, not defended.
